acceptanceCriteria: The three Core jobs are VERIFIED, the frozen wire's canonical vectors and in-repo second consumer pass with no interoperability claim, stable compatibility and platform evidence are current, every in-scope gate binds one artifact set, and the owner explicitly accepts promotion.

Owner scope amendment 2026-09-28: Flows, safe navigation, evidence-bound documentation and MCP are required 1.0 features with their exact candidate qualification, rather than optional release deferrals.

Corvint Tasks fully replaces Beamfall roadmap execution and authority: candidate-bound independent review, multi-repository integration, retained history, actual gate/cleanup qualification, fenced legacy writers, consumer migration, recovery retaining post-cutover writes, and owner-approved production activation followed by a real native completed ticket.

Automatic developer and user-facing flow documentation is useful on Corvint and Beamfall, binds original evidence, preserves human prose, detects drift, previews and safely applies bounded updates, remains idempotent, and passes native/compiled-MCP qualification. Generated documentation never accepts its own intent.
Owner requirement 2026-09-29: remove Claude as a repository contributor for the 1.0 release, completing V1-0234 with its approved rewrite plan, preserved historical releases and regenerated evidence.

Owner requirement 2026-09-29: internal specs and planning move to an approved private repository before v1 release; public consumer, license and build documentation remains usable without private access, with approved history/ref disposition and requalified immutable evidence (V1-0471).

Owner requirement 2026-09-29, issue #354: multi-repository supervisor dispatch, candidate/review binding and recoverable integration, policy-bounded configurable effort and longer or resumable runs must be qualified for Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode v2 (V1-0475); no required host may be silently deferred.

Owner scope amendment 2026-09-29: implement the six approved proof-review, explicit test-attack, portable handoff, cross-repository breakage-map, conditional instruction-doctor and disposable proof-tour workflows, retaining exact qualification limits and independent review (V1-0498 and children V1-0499..0504).

Owner scope amendment 2026-10-01: CEM reaches stable 1.0 for the main Corvint 1.0 release, with canonical task-linked evidence and actual execution support for all main test runners of every supported language, built in parallel (V1-0591 and children). Every in-scope runner/runtime/platform tuple needs retained qualification; static discovery, result import, parser availability and generic command success are not execution qualification. Frozen 0.x compatibility, portable consumer parity, Tasks applicability, independent review and explicit stable promotion bind the final artifact set.
title: Corvint 1.0 stable
